name: UGC 7767 (Hubble)
blurb: UGC 7767, an early-type galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: ugc7767-hubble
story: A nearby spheroidal galaxy with a faint X-ray glow at its core, one of the galaxies Hubble surveyed for star clusters at their hearts; this one shows no nuclear star cluster.

claims.text: UGC 7767 is one of the nearby field early-type galaxies studied by AMUSE-Field, and is not nucleated
UGC07767 was targeted in a Hubble snapshot survey of faint nearby spheroidal galaxies with faint X-ray cores, a census of accreting black holes and nuclear star clusters
